messages.subject: TITAN filterCounts.py error
parts:
Hello

Recently,  I try to use the pipeline of titan, however, when I ran

python TITANRunner/scripts/filterCounts.py 
-t project1_R0021/titan/intermediate_R0021/WGC036407_tumor_WGC036407_tumor_WGC036389_normal_WGC036389_normal_tumour_counts_hetpsns_chr23.txt
-r common_all_dbsnp_20150415.vcf.gz
-c X 
-o project1_R0021/titan/intermediate_R0021/WGC036407_tumor_WGC036407_tumor_WGC036389_normal_WGC036389_normal_tumour_counts_hetpsns_chr23.filtered.txt

An error occured:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Share/BP/yanzhiqiang/software/TITANRunner/scripts/filterCounts.py", line 50, in <module>

  File "pysam/ctabix.pyx", line 408, in pysam.ctabix.TabixFile.fetch (pysam/ctabix.c:4826)
ValueError: could not create iterator for region 'X'


The common_all_dbsnp_20150415.vcf.gz are downloaded from ncbi ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/snp/organisms/human_9606_b144_GRCh37p13/VCF/00-common_all.vcf.gz

But when I changed the '-c X' to '-c 1' (changed to another chromosome), no error !

Can you help me to solve this problem

Thank you

Zhiqiang
